author: codex

active_defaults.provenance: Conditional AA boundary/GSH recycling and finite somatic delivery; human purified G6PD Ki anchor, no human MN calibration; external glucose and other NADPH donors remain open.

units: Concentrations uM; fluxes uM/s; times seconds; fractions and ATP equivalents dimensionless. AA/GSH ledgers distinguish reference volumes from mobile water.
basis: Only Ki9uM is a measured human-enzyme anchor (Wang2002,25C,pH8,10mM MgCl2). Remaining new rates are scenarios; inherited human G6PD Km from Hernandez-Ochoa2025,25C,pH8,3mM MgCl2. Not one matched experiment.
measurement: Same-culture 13C/15N Cys/Glu/Gly and GSH pulse-chase, soma/axon GSH/GSSG; NADPH/NADP and 13C glucose/PPP flux with ATP/ADP and volume.
owners: Human G6PD kinetic assay: Wang/Engel/Lam laboratory, current availability unconfirmed. Human ALS-MN GSH relative endpoint: Mariana Pehar group. HEK glucose sensor: Alejandro San Martin group. No confirmed owner of complete healthy iPSC-MN dataset.
dependencies: AA packet composition, bath concentrations, active water, somatic coarse AA, GSH loss partition, source glucose boundary, fixed enzyme levels
tests: Unit ATP/AA/carbon; finite recovery split;8x72h+tighter repeat;9 initial electrical and post672h Burley25. See runs_v2/verification.json

AA_packet.status: scenario aggregate delivery, not identified EAAT or membrane current
AA_packet.needed: Species-specific uptake/release fluxes; possible owner unknown

soma_species.value: each species availability = coarse soma AA/20
soma_species.status: uniform surrogate, not human pool measurement

GSH_delivery.status: scenario, no motor-driven vesicle transport asserted

GSH_export_energy.unit: additional ATP per generic GSH loss/export
GSH_export_energy.status: unidentified loss process, not a calibrated ATP-dependent MRP exporter; energy cost remains a missing mechanism

somatic_redox.value: finite reduced GSH pool and synthesis only
somatic_redox.status: no newly resolved somatic GSSG/NADPH cycle; detailed antioxidant redox is in axon branch

GSH_loss.value: generic GSH loss routed to recoverable exported pool; recovery fraction0/.5/.9; GS-HNE excluded

extracellular_volume.value: sum of active soma and axon water
extracellular_volume.status: scenario volume for a shared precursor compartment; not extracellular anatomy

recovery_partition.value: separate finite capacity and inward-gradient uptake by soma and axon, scaled to their active water
recovery_partition.status: replaces invalid delivery of all somatic GSH products into axon; not specific transporters

AA_delivery_energy.unit: ATP equivalent per imported or recovered residue
AA_delivery_energy.status: effective transport cost; not explicit Na-coupled transport

NADPH_carbon.value: external glucose/G6P and other reducing-substrate boundary
NADPH_carbon.status: PPP material ledger connected; whole-neuron glucose competition unimplemented

ATP_opportunity.status: diagnostic maximum theoretical yield, NOT added hydrolysis

temperature.value: source assays25C; transfer factor1; no neuronal Q10 calibration

PPP_reserve.status: rat-culture fold changes are source scenarios, not human boundaries. Flux>fresh glucose is possible with carbon recycling; no blanket exclusion of89

inherited_NADPH.units: uM for pools/Km/Ki; uM/s for glucose flux; s for return tau; fractions/folds/ATP-per-glucose dimensionless
inherited_NADPH.status: Exact inherited scenario constants, not healthy human bounds. Human-enzyme Km/Ki anchors have different assay Mg conditions; glucose, recycling and non-PPP donors are uncalibrated.
inherited_NADPH.measurement: Isotope-resolved glucose/PPP and alternate-donor fluxes with NADPH/NADP, G6P/pentoses and compartment volume in healthy human iPSC-MNs
inherited_NADPH.owner: Complete human-MN dataset owner unknown; enzyme and HEK benchmarks listed under owners
